subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should OpenClaw restore the released Discord `channels.discord.allowFrom` elevated fallback, or keep current main's explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` contract?
rationale: The choice changes who can reach elevated host exec from Discord; latest release docs promised the fallback, but current main now documents explicit elevated allowlists as required and the only open fix PR is conflicting.

options.title: Keep explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Treat the current docs correction as the intended security contract, ship it, close the conflicting fork PR, and close this issue once the released docs no longer promise the fallback.

options.title: Restore a Discord plugin fallback
options.body: Implement `elevated.allowFromFallback` in the Discord plugin and reuse the same resolved allowlist in runtime auth and diagnostics with focused security tests.

options.title: Pause for security review
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open until a maintainer/security review decides whether the fallback is compatible with safe elevated defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit elevated allowlists
recommendation.body: Treat the current docs correction as the intended security contract, ship it, close the conflicting fork PR, and close this issue once the released docs no longer promise the fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current docs correction and the recent elevated/plugin-boundary history most directly tied to the product/security choice.
